summary: Del Norte County lookout tower on Monkey Creek Ridge, built 1940 under the Siskiyou National Forest; a 1956 water drop is recorded; listed as gone, with no description of what remains.

facts.design: Timber tower with a cab: the 1940 history gives 10 feet round; survey notes of 1942 and 1952 give about 14 feet square and 20 to 30 feet high
facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as Tower, status Gone; no removal date or description of remains found
facts.agency: Siskiyou National Forest (Forest Lookouts page also files it under Six Rivers National Forest)

events.note: A 10-foot round timber tower with a cab was constructed, per a history of the Siskiyou National Forest quoted on the Forest Lookouts page
Coast and Geodetic Survey station described at the apex of the lookout tower, about 14 by 14 by 20 feet high
Coast and Geodetic Survey recovery note describes a standard Forest Service lookout house about 14 feet square on legs about 15 feet high, top about 30 feet up
August 1956: fire lookout Eddie Barnard had no nearby water; four five-gallon cans dropped by cargo chute from an airplane

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief has 3.0 m, which matches the 10-foot figure in the 1940 history. The 1942 station description gives about 20 feet high and the 1952 recovery note gives the top about 30 feet up. The sources disagree and no value is chosen, so height_m is not set.

The 1942 station description gives about 19 miles northeast of Crescent City; the 1952 recovery note gives about 24 miles airline northeast of Crescent City. Both are recorded in the story; no single value is chosen.

notes_for_editor: Height is unresolved: 1940 history 10 ft, 1942 station about 20 ft high, 1952 recovery top about 30 ft. The brief's 3.0 m was left out of facts; the editor should decide whether to keep it. Peakbagging's table lists Monkey Creek Ridge without the '(LO site)' tag it gives Mike's Peak and Mosquito Ridge, so it may record the site differently; check before relying on it. A search result for a Ride with GPS route titled Monkey Creek Ridge Lookout Site did not load its page text, so it is not used. No source describes the site today or public access. No photos found.
